headers_note: redis.io 的代码示例是 `##### <语言名>` 划的 codetabs。该层级不在 h1/h2/h3 里时，同一片会混进两种语言的代码（实测 35% 的 Examples chunk 混语言）—— 切分器看不见它，citation 也就说不出是哪个语言。改 h1..h5 后混语言 0%，citation 形如 `Redis · SET · Examples / Go`。
normalization_note: 14/20 份文档含页面模板样板块 `## Code Examples Legend`（官方 metadata 的 tableOfContents 里没有它）。它在切分前被移除并记账，见 manifest.summary.normalization。

units.title: SET
units.description: Sets the string value of a key, ignoring its type. The key is created if it doesn't exist.
units.syntax: SET key value [NX | XX | IFEQ ifeq-value | IFNE ifne-value | IFDEQ ifdeq-digest | IFDNE ifdne-digest] [GET] [EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds | PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | KEEPTTL]

units.title: GET
units.description: Returns the string value of a key.

units.title: INCR
units.description: Increments the integer value of a key by one. Uses 0 as initial value if the key doesn't exist.

units.title: LPUSH
units.description: Prepends one or more elements to a list. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

units.title: RPUSH
units.description: Appends one or more elements to a list. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

units.title: LRANGE
units.description: Returns a range of elements from a list.

units.title: BRPOP
units.description: Removes and returns the last element in a list. Blocks until an element is available otherwise. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

units.title: BLPOP
units.description: Removes and returns the first element in a list. Blocks until an element is available otherwise. Deletes the list if the last element was popped.

units.title: HSET
units.description: Creates or modifies the value of a field in a hash.

units.title: HGET
units.description: Returns the value of a field in a hash.

units.title: SADD
units.description: Adds one or more members to a set. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.

units.title: SMEMBERS
units.description: Returns all members of a set.

units.title: ZADD
units.description: Adds one or more members to a sorted set, or updates their scores. Creates the key if it doesn't exist.
units.syntax: ZADD key [NX | XX] [GT | LT] [CH] [INCR] score member [score member ...]

units.title: ZRANGE
units.description: Returns members in a sorted set within a range of indexes.
units.syntax: ZRANGE key start stop [BYSCORE | BYLEX] [REV] [LIMIT offset count] [WITHSCORES]

units.title: EXPIRE
units.description: Sets the expiration time of a key in seconds.
units.syntax: EXPIRE key seconds [NX | XX | GT | LT]

units.title: TTL
units.description: Returns the expiration time in seconds of a key.

units.title: PUBLISH
units.description: Posts a message to a channel.

units.title: SUBSCRIBE
units.description: Listens for messages published to channels.

units.title: MULTI
units.description: Starts a transaction.

units.title: WATCH
units.description: Monitors changes to keys to determine the execution of a transaction.
